holdout_lon.note: these longitude columns are held out of TRAINING in both stages, so each scope aggregate here is a blend of trained and never-trained pixels; the *_trainlon / *_holdlon splits beside every scope are the unblended numbers, and *_trainlon is the one that answers 'what did the model learn'. The blend is deflationary -- an untrained pixel scores low -- so a parent aggregate is a lower bound on its own _trainlon.

inputs.doc: E-043b-PHASE · Rolls the published seed-0 xl144 all-longitude stage-2 head (head-weights-e043b-xl144-nolonhold-s0, trained by #414 for 200,000 steps on the frozen f3_anchor41M codec) twelve months forward beside the frozen e017_u1_s0 validation gate, and hindcasts each head from SIX context ends (2004-12, 2014-12, 2018-09, 2020-06, 2022-03, 2024-03) instead of one — the CALENDAR-vs-CONTEXT phase discriminator · params 40.693M codec (frozen) + 211.353M head · stage sroll (eval-only; NOTHING trains, the steps field is the codec checkpoint's own count) · data family3_na025 (C 39, T 516, sha256 adcbe700fb6e) · arch codec 576x10, 8 heads, d_dec 768, d_z 64, patch 3; head 1024x16, K 24, stencil 145, ring spiral:111,4444,0.71,0.5 · steps x batch 60,000 x 512 (= f3_anchor41M's recorded step count, ZERO training steps) · resume !run-62,run-63 (f3_anchor41M, frozen). WHY: every head's unforced future roll mode-locks to the calendar — the gate peaks every 12 months, the #414/#426 nolonhold pair exactly every 36 with peaks pinned to Nov 2027/+36/+36 and the two seeds phase-identical — and from ONE context end that has two explanations with no way to choose: the model REPLAYS THE CALENDAR (phase is a function of the season token, so any roll peaks in the same months whatever state it started from), or its phase is SELECTED BY ITS STATE (the context end decides where in the cycle the trajectory starts). PRE-REGISTERED READING, on long_multi[*].sv_des: if the peak MONTHS are invariant across the six context ends, the phase is the calendar's and the hindcast tracking is replay, not skill; if the peaks shift with the context end, the phase is state-selected and the 36-month lock is a property of the rolled state. Both outcomes are results. The gate head pays the same five extra rolls and that is not waste: it is the same discriminator on a 12-month mode-locker with the longest archive — an independent second reading. GATE: e017_u1_s0 is rolled FIRST and must reproduce horizon_auc 0.643 within GATE_TOL 0.0101 with len(heads) 2, or this run is VOID — the extra hindcasts change no scored, gate or band block (asserted in tests/test_roll_long_multi.py). COST: 2 heads x (714 base + 1,200 extra hindcast) = 3,828 roll steps, ~10-16 h (gate steps are ~5x cheaper than the main head's 15.06 s/step), ~$3-4.7 at $0.294/h.
